{{#len:{{#switch:{{{mode|}}}
  |portfolio={{#switch:{{{nom_type|}}}
    |FA={{#dplreplace:{{#dplreplace:{{{{{1}}}}}|/((?!File:FA-Icon-retro\.svg).)*/|}}|/\n/|}}
    |GA={{#dplreplace:{{#dplreplace:{{{{{1}}}}}|/((?!File:GA-Icon-retro\.svg).)*/|}}|/\n/|}}
    |CA={{#dplreplace:{{#dplreplace:{{{{{1}}}}}|/((?!File:CA-Icon-retro\.svg).)*/|}}|/\n/|}}
  }}
  |table={{#dplreplace:{{#dplreplace:{{#dplreplace:{{#dplreplace:{{{{{1}}}}}|/\[\[Wookieepedia:[ ]?[A-z]+ article nominations\/.+/|###}}|/((?!\#\#\#).)*/|}}|/#+/|1}}|/\n/|}}
  |alphabet={{#dplreplace:{{#dplreplace:{{#dplreplace:{{#dplreplace:{{#dplreplace:{{{{{1}}}}}|/\*\[.+/|###}}|/\*'+\[.+/|###}}|/((?!\#\#\#).)*/|}}|/#+/|1}}|/\n/|}}
}}}}<noinclude>

==Usage==
*Status Article Portfolio: <nowiki>{{StatusArticleCounter|<page>|mode=portfolio|nom_type=FA}}</nowiki>
*Status Article Table: <nowiki>{{StatusArticleCounter|<page>|mode=table}}</nowiki>
*Alphabetical Status Article Table: <nowiki>{{StatusArticleCounter|<page>|mode=alphabet}}</nowiki>

Note: this template looks on pages for instances of [[:File:FA-Icon-retro.svg]], [[:File:GA-Icon-retro.svg]], and [[:File:GA-Icon-retro.svg]].
